sources.title: AI-Based OPD Consultant for Paediatric Care - GitHub
sources.snippet: This project develops an AI-based clinical decision support system for pediatric outpatient (OPD) consultations. The system assists doctors by analyzing patient symptoms, medical history, and clinical guidelines to provide evidence-based diagnostic and investigative recommendations.
